name: scholarium-research-agent-pipeline
principle: Search hits are metadata; downloaded and read PDFs become evidence cards; manuscript claims must remain evidence-bounded.

primary.login_policy: User logs in to CAS in the browser scansci-pdf opens; only session cookies are stored, never a password.
primary.why_primary: This tier is the only one that routes the request through WebVPN — the publisher hostname is rewritten into the wvpn.ustc.edu.cn URL form and the ticket cookie is attached, so the publisher sees the institution's IP and subscription.
primary.reuse_policy: scansci-pdf validates the saved session before each batch; on expiry it returns needs_login instead of stalling.

fallback.use_only_for: DOIs the institutional tier could not resolve, plus open-access landing pages.
fallback.known_limitation: This tier opens the raw publisher URL from the local IP; it reads the WebVPN cookie only to report login state. Expect anti_bot_challenge/access_denied on subscription content.
fallback.legacy: paper-downloader mode=direct_cookie_jar reads Scholarium/secrets/webvpn-cookies.txt; use only for known direct PDF URLs.

access_profile.hard_rule: paper-downloader itself must not implement WebVPN host encryption. Institutional routing is delegated to the installed scansci-pdf package via the scansci-institutional skill. Pirate mirrors stay disabled (scihub_enabled=False is forced on every call).

steps.input: query_manifest.query_v0 or the query after any relevance-driven deepening
steps.note: Optional supplementary source, gated by Pipeline settings (default on). Skips gracefully with a labeled error in the step detail if Scholarium/secrets/pubmed-api-key.txt is missing/invalid; does not block the run.

steps.input: query_manifest.query_v0 or the query after any relevance-driven deepening
steps.note: Optional supplementary source, gated by Pipeline settings (default on). Auth is header-based (x-api-key); skips gracefully if Scholarium/secrets/semantic-scholar-api-key.txt is missing/invalid.

steps.input: query_manifest.query_v0 or the query after any relevance-driven deepening
steps.note: Optional supplementary source, gated by Pipeline settings (default on). Even with a valid key, full results often require a subscribing institution's IP range; empty results are not necessarily a broken key. Skips gracefully.

steps.requires: A valid WebVPN/CARSI session in scansci-pdf; on needs_login run scansci_pdf_vpnsci_login (or: scansci-pdf instsci-login)
steps.note: Primary download tier. Routes through WebVPN, so subscription content actually resolves.

steps.input: the records tier 5 could not download
steps.requires: Persistent browser session; run paper-downloader mode=login if needs_login is returned
steps.note: Fallback tier only. Skipped entirely when tier 5 covered every record.
Executable alias for the PDF evidence-card step.
Notes are shelved by evidence level. Downloaded-but-unread PDFs stay on the metadata-only shelf.

steps.input: existing literature notes + downloaded PDFs + evidence cards
steps.note: Idempotent. Rerun after any reading pass to promote notes from metadata-only to fulltext-read.

steps.input: run-scoped evidence cards + Agent semantic entity/relation extraction
steps.note: Deterministic offline renderer; every scientific edge retains provenance and inferred edges stay visibly unverified.

steps.input: deduped records + downloaded PDFs + evidence cards + download logs
steps.note: Hard precondition. Both writing steps re-evaluate it internally and fail closed if it cannot be loaded.

steps.requires: evidence-gate status pass (or an explicit, reasoned override that stamps the draft as not citable)
evidence-gate status pass; polishing an evidence-thin draft only makes it more persuasive

evidence_floor.rationale: A run can complete every step on 1 downloaded PDF and still emit a finished-looking draft. These floors make that impossible.
evidence_floor.on_failure: Emit Research/retrieval-download-diagnostic.md instead of a manuscript; the run is a retrieval trial, not a result.

stop_rules: If query manifest is empty, stop and ask the researcher to clarify concepts.
If only metadata exists, do not make strong evidence claims.
If the evidence floor is not met, nature-writing and nature-polishing must not run; output the retrieval/download diagnostic instead.
If the evidence gate cannot be loaded, fail closed: no draft.
Notes without a read full text stay on the metadata-only shelf and may not back mechanism, kinetic, or novelty claims.
If the scansci-pdf WebVPN/CARSI session is expired, report needs_login and ask the researcher to re-run the instsci login; do not let the browser fallback silently become the only tier.
If browser session is missing or expired, stop institutional download and ask the researcher to run paper-downloader mode=login.
If PDF reading fails, mark the paper as needs_manual_review.
